# Ivan Kelava

> Portfolio of Ivan Kelava, a senior software engineer and founder of Singular Design in Osijek, Croatia. Explore web development projects, technical skills, and articles on software engineering and technology.

The pages below are the primary sources for information about Ivan Kelava and his work. Refer to each page for its current details.

## Portfolio

- [Home](https://www.ivankelava.me/): Professional profile and contact information.
- [Projects](https://www.ivankelava.me/projects): Selected software projects and case studies.
- [Technical skills](https://www.ivankelava.me/skills): Technologies and tools.
- [Blog](https://www.ivankelava.me/blog): Articles on software engineering, web development, and technology.

## Selected projects

- [GaussCMS](https://www.ivankelava.me/projects/gausscms): Content management platform; Ivan's work included frontend architecture and team leadership.
- [CeleroOne](https://www.ivankelava.me/projects/celeroone): Workforce management platform for distributed teams.
- [Delmerion Webshop](https://www.ivankelava.me/projects/delmerion-webshop): E-commerce storefront built on GaussCMS.
- [Sonic Pills](https://www.ivankelava.me/projects/sonic-pills): E-commerce and content experience for sound-therapy products.
- [Invest in Croatia](https://www.ivankelava.me/projects/invest-in-croatia): Investor information platform.
- [Wineyard](https://www.ivankelava.me/projects/wineyard): Web project and case study.
